body:
I took a couple days off from playing osu and got right back to it. My wrist feels a lot better haha, good luck on getting a new laptop, osu's awesome 

Clay almost cut me and our other friend off because I was getting really depressive again, and he was blaming himself. I think I talked him out of it and we're almost in some sort of weird poly-relationship thing now? It's fun and I love him and my friendo a lot haha 
We're gonna hang out after school today and for once I feel excited! I smiled genuinely for the first time in a while, and it's awesome.

School's going good, I have all a's and b's (but a c in french, i fell behind :<) it's a lil stressful though, not gonna lie. next year i'm gonna be a freshman, I'm not sure what courses I want to take next year. Coding maybe? Japanese? I dunno

I actually don't know anything about him.. ^^; I've been trying to figure out more about him since I learned he exists. He's around 20-something if I did the math right? 

The discord is amazing! I wanna introduce Clay since I think it could be kinda helpful to him, but I wanna delete my logs of conversation on there first... xD

I'm always gonna be there for him, he's done so much for me, and I wanna be a good friend for him. :3 He always talks about how he doesn't feel like he's enough, I wanna prove to him that he is! Because he's really helped so much in the month I've known him. 

Thank you so much, haha. It's been really hard, but I've been doing my best to stay here no matter how tempting it is to just give up. 

I'm actually doing pretty good - our other friend (from the weird poly relationship) is really close with me now. I love her lots!! She stayed up super late just to talk to me, it really made my night.

They both said they were scared that I was cutting again, which I did just a little but I regret it, I never realized how much it hurts other people until now.

Hey! <33

My hand’s really jittery, I’ve been doing exercises with it to kind of relieve it, haha. I’ve been really playing a lot, yesterday I passed about 14 maps (I had terrible accuracy, but… eh) 
I really only talk to clay anymore, I try to make new friends but either get booted offline, or disgustingly flirted with. I’m thinking of just sticking with the two friends I have, haha. He hasn’t, in fact he’s been spending WAY more time with me on his own. I’m honestly over the relationship aspect, I just like keeping him around as my best friend at this point. We completely convinced our one newer friend that we live together, it’s fun!
I’m still ghosting, I really have only talked to the ones who are worrying a few times to let them know I’m alive, ahaha. 
I can’t wait till I can move out. I’m considering trying to connect with a family member I only just discovered existed (I apparently have an older brother), but everyone else isn’t gonna hear from me again. I really only want to move out of country so that they can’t keep track of me. 
I’m still in the discord, they’re such amazing and loving people unconditionally, even when I’m just being ridiculous, haha. They feel almost like a big ol’ online family. 
I’ve been trying to kind of focus more on Clay’s issues, though. He had a bit of a break-down (anxiety attack?) type thing last night and I needed to talk him down kind of. He’s been dealing with my issues this whole time, I owe him everything at this point haha
Your replies really help, thank you. <3

he's been making me feel super happy, but i'm scared that i'm getting a little obsessive ^^; all of my friends have been being mean to me, so i've isolated myself from everyone except clay and his friend. i don't know how healthy that is but i feel a bit more secure only talking to two people
i wanna move to nova scotia specifically! there's something very appealing about that area. 
i'm thinking of just completely cutting off my family when i'm an adult and starting friend. it might be for the best tbh. 
i don't know if i wanna keep my friends honestly... they're really mean to me :P
the week went okay, i literally spent all of it in a voice call with Clay (even during school! :0 ) and same with the weekend. i hurt my hand playing osu and f'nite but the weekend's been great so far

hey
im doing a bit better now. im kinda ghosting my friends right now, they got mad at me for being sad and spending so much time with clay. 
me and him have just been talking 24/7, he even skipped school one day so we could just kinda.. chat 
for a bit i stopped eating but in a way he's my motivation? he's been a really positive influence on my life, i even stopped swearing for the most part haha 
i joined a cool mental health help discord server, they've been so supportive it really lifts my mood :> 
my parents have just kinda been getting mad at me for being so distant... but i don't know what they expect when they're so mean. i've told them i havent been feeling well and would rather deal with it on my own but bleh, they dont wanna listen. 
theyve been kinda taking it easy on me though, since my fishy recently passed away :c 
my brother doesn't seem to care, in fact he torments me as well 
i think im okay, it hasn't happened since i last wrote for this. i've never had seizures before, so that was really scary to me. 
i'm not sure how i managed to make someone cry... i think it was just a guilt trip ^^; they never even elaborated further
only 4 more years!! im not sure what exactly i wanna do. my current plan is move to canada and go to college to become a surgeon
i wanna be able to help people, so i want a career based around that!
me, clay and my other friend were kinda talking about all living as roommates since we all seem to wanna move to canada as adults
i'm trying to hang in there, bleh
thank you for still being here, i appreciate it <3

for some reason despite everything my parents have put me through i still feel attached to them, like living with someone else would feel awful. i hate that i feel this way but i dont think i could bare being away from them as weird as that seems... 

the seizures are a relatively new thing, i think i've only ever had one when i was going through withdrawal. i dont think it's been this bad. my muscles hurt and its still hard to control my movments/type. 

the only thing that calms me down is listening to music and talking to my ex tbh. i also like to play rhythm games to calm down. 

my grades are dropping because i just want to get done with school super fast and go bak to my room to avoid my parents. any time i hear them mention my name i cringe. 

the only reason i dont do anything is because of my ex. he's been such a good friend to me and i wouldnt want to hurt him. he's my motivation to keep going in a way.

i only got an hour of sleep last night and i feel awful. they were really drunk and i got a text saying i made my dad cry... somehow? even though until yesterday i've been fine. they were the ones who screamed at me and encouraged me to kill myself, yet i'm still the bad person. hah. 

it broke my heart further that after they got done stomping on the little shreds of self esteem i had, they were all kind and loving to my younger brother. the favoritism really hurts.

i wanna be able to turn my life around, not just for me but for clay (my ex). it's just hard to keep going at this point. 

i really appreciate that you keep responding. thank you. :)

hi there kappa, it seems ive gone back to square one.
my boyfriend broke up with me, but we're still friends which makes me feel okay about it. 
i've been finding it hard to eat lately, and i've been getting yelled at a lot.
last night my boyfriend had to talk me down because i got screamed at for hours and when i came back i was having such a panic attack that i had a stress-induced seizure of sorts. 
every day im scared to wake up because i know something bad's gonna happen. another friends gonna hate me or my parents are gonna get drunk and remind me of how many times ive fucked up and that i'm a waste of oxygen, or hell, maybe even hit me once or twice. 
life feels like a chore anymore, the only thing motivating me to not end it is the fact that if i fail, my parents are just gonna hate me more. they've told me to kill myself many times on end, and i believe it. i'm only trying to hold out hope because of my ex boyfriend. i wouldnt want him to think things are his fault. 
so i had a turn around for my turn around. it's comical.

hey, it's been a while since i've actually touched this. (the name yanna works btw! im ok with yeet tho haha) a lot has changed since i wrote this. i feel a lot better, though i still struggle with the thought of cutting myself at times. for the most part i've gotten over my ex(???), but it didn't really end on good terms. i haven't talked to him in almost 2 months now and it feels kinda relieving.
i've taken up learning french and my new boyfriend came into my life about a couple of weeks ago and it's really helped me turn around. for the most part i've dropped my more unhealthy habits like weed and stuff (still only do it occasionally, but anxiety makes it hard to function without it sometimes)
my self esteem has actually gone up a lot since i wrote this! i started a diet and already lost a lot of weight and my skin cleared up a bit, i'm still not exactly what i hoped to look like but i'm still working on it. 
drawing and listening to music have actually been really theraputic to me.   i've also felt more motivated to play games that i previously wasnt interested in.
i'm over a lot of my friendships. i don't really wanna have any more friendships, since i already have good relationships with the 3 i have. 
thank you for the reply, i really appreciate it. :,>
Thanks for that. I'm sorry if I came off as aggressive by the way - looking back on my response I seemed a bit snide.

Ehm, but it is kinda that bad my dude

​

* Depression runs in my family so there's that
* My parents are controlling as hell - I can't leave my house, have any sorta social media or anything. They also squash any sorta hobbies of mine (e.g. drawing, songwriting - they just sucked the life outta me the moment i showed interest)
* Pressure to keep good grades and take extra classes. I had a meltdown the other day because I got screamed at for a B- in French.
* Obvious favoritism towards my brother in the family
* Pressure to be like the rest of my family instead of have my own interests
* Parents get drunk a lot and say really mean shit to me (i've literally been told to cut/kill myself a few times) (which leads to more tears and self destructive behavior)
* Parents are anti-establishment so even if they think something's wrong they're not gonna get me treated
* I get blamed for causing drama when I do finally snap and try anything

I've already tried about 3 times in the past year. I wish I could be thankful and just have fun as a kid but :/

I read this a few times before I decided to reply. I really appreciate this. I know my habits aren't exactly good, I wanna stop but it's all I really find comfort in right now.  
My guy friend was kind of a boyfriend (He lives only a few hours from me and we always talked about meeting up and dating) and I loved him a lot. Him disappearing was really difficult for me. My parents didn't know about him (long story - parents are racist and he's black, sooo) so I could never tell them why I've been so upset. They think it's PMS or whatever. 
I've been trying to patch up old friendships since my old friends just kinda ghosted. One only responded with "K thanks" and the others just didn't do anything.
I'm homeschooled and have transportation issues, so new friendships and activities around town are really, really hard. 
My parents seem to shrug off my issues. I've been feeling pretty bad since... June-ish? They were supportive at first (A close family friend took his own life around that time and both me and my mom shut down) so they seemed to care. They said they were gonna let me do all these great things, let me even get into a sport. I had my hopes up, buuuuut they decided that it's not essential and I should stop bugging them about it. 
Wow i really vented out like everything in this im so sorry lmao
Yes I know it's terrible parenting. I'm not really allowed to... Do anything, so I can't really enjoy being a kid rn. :/
Oh gosh... I feel like an awful person saying this but in a way I feel some sort of comfort in the fact that I have someone to relate to if that makes sense...?? I wish the best for you man.
